subject: Consolidated ledger split + step-down remit proposal
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@brighttrack.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: payables@brighttrack.com, m.rossi@brighttrack.eu
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: Starting the billing construct discussion (ledger split + remit)

Hi Sean —

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. Finance asked me to put together the core asks so we can align on terms and the ledgers we'll need for month-end. High level items: 

- We need a single consolidated invoice each month but with a split ledger by entity (US / EU) so our AP can route VAT correctly.
- Requesting Net60 for the first 3 months of the engagement (pilot + ramp), then transition to Net30 once usage commitments are met.
- Temporary credit cap: BrightTrack is asking for an initial credit limit of $300,000 while we go through onboarding; we understand this may be reviewed at 90 days.
- VAT evidence: Marco (cc'd) will push EU VAT registration and a VAT confirmation letter; please let us know any other documentation you need.

I've attached an export of our expected Q3 ledger (BrightTrack_Q3_Ledger.xlsx) and a copy of the latest SOW (SOW_v3.pdf) so you can see projected monthly invoices. Can you map how Redwood would produce the invoice(s) and what the step-down to Net30 would require operationally?

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Finance Ops — BrightTrack Inc.
laura.chen@brighttrack.com

--- attachment: BrightTrack_Q3_Ledger.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)
--- attachment: SOW_v3.pdf (pdf, 480KB)

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@brighttrack.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 10:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Starting the billing construct discussion (ledger split + remit)

Laura —

Appreciate the clear summary and the attachments. Outline below of what we can do and the conditions tied to Net60 -> Net30: 

1) Invoicing / ledger split
   - We can emit one consolidated invoice per calendar month with line-item grouping by billing entity (US / EU). Each grouping will include a ledger code that your AP system can use for routing and VAT treatment.
   - We'll include VAT registration numbers on the invoice header for the EU grouping and a separate tax line so your AP team has what they need.

2) Net terms proposal
   - Proposed: Net60 for the first 90 days (covers pilot + ramp), with a scheduled review at day 75. If there are no payment exceptions and usage is within the forecasts in your spreadsheet, terms move to Net30 effective the following billing month.
   - If payments are late or usage exceeds forecast by >40% without a committed PO, we keep Net60 and require a credit hold until remediation.

3) Credit limit
   - We can provision a provisional credit cap of $250,000 (note: lower than your ask) for onboarding; this will be reviewed at 90 days against payment history, pipeline, and actual usage.
   - If BrightTrack can provide a 30-day rolling PO or an AP pre-authorization letter, we can increase the provisional cap to $300,000 immediately.

4) VAT / evidence
   - Marco's EU VAT registration document is perfect. We also need a short VAT confirmation email from your EU finance entity and a remit-to entity confirmation (who will receive funds for the EU lines).

5) Operational items / attachments
   - I've attached a proposed remit schedule CSV (Remit_Schedule_Proposal.csv) showing ledger codes and suggested invoice line grouping.
   - Finance (cc marissa_cole) will run a credit check and draft the contract addendum to capture the step-down schedule and credit guardrails.

Next steps: 
- Can Marco send the VAT docs and confirm the EU remit-to entity?
- Laura, if you can confirm whether BrightTrack can issue a rolling PO or AP pre-auth, we can provision the higher cap immediately.

I'll have Marissa run the internal review and follow up with the contractual language.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0122

Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:40:00 +0000

Hi Sean / Laura —

We can provide the EU VAT registration (attached) and confirm that invoices for the EU ledger should be remitted to BrightTrack EU SRL, IBAN **** **** ****, with the VAT number included in the invoice header.

On the terms/credit: BrightTrack prefers to keep the initial credit cap at $300k given the expected burst in month 2. We can commit to issuing a rolling PO covering estimated spend for months 1-3 which should satisfy the pre-authorization requirement you mentioned.

One request from our side: if Redwood is applying a conditional step to Net30 at day 90, can you build in an interim reporting checkpoint (weekly invoice reconciliation for the last 30 days) so our AR team can confirm there are no disputed charges before the terms shorten? That will help avoid surprise holds.

Thanks,
Marco Rossi
Head of Finance (EMEA) — BrightTrack

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai

Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Starting the billing construct discussion (ledger split + remit)

Marco / Laura —

This all sounds workable. Summary / commitments from Redwood: 

- We will issue a consolidated monthly invoice with US/EU line-grouping and ledger codes, including the EU VAT number on the EU section.
- Redwood is prepared to provision a provisional $300,000 credit cap upon receipt of the rolling PO that covers months 1-3 and the EU VAT cert. Marissa will run the formal credit check this afternoon and log the provisional cap.
- We will maintain Net60 for the first 90 days with a scheduled review at day 75. If reconciliation shows no disputes and payments are on time we will move terms to Net30 starting the next calendar month; we will publish a weekly reconciliation report in the final 30 days before the change as requested.

Action items:
- Laura: please send the rolling PO to marissa_cole@redwood.ai and cc payables@brighttrack.com.
- Marco: thanks for the VAT cert; please confirm the EU remit-to IBAN in your next reply so finance can bake that into the invoice header.
- Marissa: please initiate the credit check and circulate the draft addendum for signature (I linked the HubSpot deal above for reference).

I'll mark this thread as the canonical billing thread for the pilot. If anything changes on your side, reply-all and we'll adjust.

Best regards,
Sean Gallagher
